title: Complete simple committed-input submodule conformance fixtures and call-count evidence
outcome: Add evidence for the documented simple submodule contract without changing the admission rule.
acceptance: Focused fixtures cover an old-form .git directory child, a staged gitlink pin, a child outside the root through a symlink, and a child that is not its own worktree, with named refusal where required.
Record actual outer and internal Git process counts for representative initialized direct-child captures; distinguish source-derived outer counts from observed subprocess counts.
